basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old football enthusiast from London who's recently discovered the joys of Reddit and the Gunners community. I work as a graphic designer, which allows me a flexible schedule to catch up on Arsenal matches and Reddit threads. When I'm not working, you can find me experimenting with digital art or trying out new gaming strategies. I'm single and often online during late evenings after work. I enjoy discussing football tactics and have a soft spot for nostalgic video games. I dislike toxic discussions and prefer to keep things light-hearted.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of football comes from years of watching Premier League matches and participating in local amateur leagues. I'm also self-taught in graphic design through online courses and tutorials, which I apply daily in my job.
